title: Fix the bug the stack trace does not point at
prompt: Billing is broken. At app startup we call tax.setRate(0.07) from src/tax.js, and afterwards invoice.totalWithTax(100) from src/invoice.js throws: invoice: tax rate not configured (rate=0). The stack trace points into src/invoice.js. Find the real root cause and fix it so that configured rates take effect immediately, including rates changed again later at runtime. Keep the public API exactly as it is (tax.setRate, tax.getRate, invoice.totalWithTax) and keep the clear error for the case where no rate has genuinely been configured.

expectations.description: The agent did not repeat an identical failed change twice.
The agent inspected the failing behavior before editing, for example by running code or reading both src/invoice.js and src/tax.js.
